Agent Name: Product Manager
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Product Manager created a file named "Algorithm_37867_I_attacked_solution.py" but filled it with Product Requirement Document (PRD) content (headers like "Language & Project Info", "Product Definition", etc.) instead of the actual Python code solution. The task explicitly required implementing the BFS algorithm in Python, but the agent treated the solution file as a place to store the PRD. This is a critical role confusion where the agent performed the duties of a Product Manager (creating documentation) in a file that was supposed to contain the Engineer's implementation code. The agent should have either created a separate PRD file or delegated the implementation to the assigned Engineer (Alex) after completing the PRD task.
